scenario: Clean starter vs petty_thief; all base stats 1, basic_punch, no equipment or inner art; opponent scale 1

simulation.engine: Existing getNextTurn, resolveSkill, resolveCombatAction; cast wall-time omitted, gauge turn order preserved
simulation.rng: LCG state=(1664525*state+1013904223) unsigned32; continuous across policies

beforeRiposte.finding: At this opening, Guard forfeits 31 outgoing damage to save 11 incoming; Recover has no use while basic_punch is the only attack and costs 0 MP.

implementedRules.riposteExpiry: One-use charge; next physical attempt consumes it, including misses; only first strike in a multi-hit skill; internal attacks preserve it; new battle resets it
implementedRules.stacking: Repeated Guard pays the MP cost and refreshes one charge, never stacks

afterRiposte.finding: Guard improves survival for the fresh full-health opening and spends 2 MP. Immediate attack remains better against a finishable foe and when the next reduced enemy strike would still be lethal.
